title:
Comment of Elizabeth Kotz in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151697.txt
documents.text:
Elizabeth Kotz, Chicago, IL.
I am writing to request for this project to be put on indefinite hold. Constructing and operating a data center underwater, with the known risks these structures present to the environment in addition to the pollution they cause, is dangerous and completely unnecessary. Oceanic ecosystems are already under serious strain. Please consider how profoundly damaging an undersea data center would be to the animal populations and all life in this region.
